name: PT Asuransi Jiwa Sinarmas MSIG Tbk
summary: PT Asuransi Jiwa Sinarmas MSIG Tbk provides life insurance products in Indonesia. It offers multi invest, personal accident, medical, hospital protection, and kid insurance; unit link insurance; and Sharia insurance. The company also provides bancassurance products; group insurance products; and online insurance services. It serves individual and group customers through 46 service and marketing offices. The company was formerly known as PT Asuransi Jiwa Eka Life and changed its name to PT Asuransi Jiwa Sinarmas MSIG in 2007. PT Asuransi Jiwa Sinarmas MSIG Tbk was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Central Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Asuransi Jiwa Sinarmas MSIG Tbk is a subsidiary Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co., Ltd.
